feedback_text: The professor explained concepts clearly and the lectures were easy to follow and understand.
Teaching quality was excellent, the instructor made difficult topics simple with great examples.
Lectures were engaging and the professor was always well prepared with clear explanations.
The instructor rushed through the material and explanations were often confusing and unclear.
Great teaching style, the lecturer used real world examples that made the concepts stick.
The teacher was knowledgeable but the delivery was monotonous and hard to stay focused on.
Placement preparation was weak, we had almost no mock interviews before company drives.
The placement cell needs to invite more companies, very few visited our campus this year.
Career support was poor and there was no guidance on resume building or interview skills.
We need better placement training with aptitude tests and coding rounds practice sessions.
The placement process felt disorganized and communication about drives was always last minute.
More industry connections and internship opportunities would really improve our job prospects.
The library closes too early and there are never enough seats during exam season.
We need more updated textbooks in the library, most reference books are old editions.
Library resources are limited and access to digital journals and databases is restricted.
Please extend library hours and add more quiet study zones for group and solo work.
The library wifi is slow and many e-books listed in the catalog are not actually available.
Not enough copies of core textbooks, students end up fighting over the few available ones.
Assignments were graded unfairly and there was no rubric explaining how marks were awarded.
Grading felt inconsistent between sections and feedback on submitted work was very delayed.
The assignment deadlines overlapped across courses making the workload impossible to manage.
We need clear rubrics and faster turnaround on graded assignments and project evaluations.
Too many assignments with unclear instructions, and grading criteria were never explained.
Project grading was subjective and different evaluators gave very different marks for similar work.
The counseling and mental health support services were helpful during a very stressful semester.
We need more academic advisors, it is hard to get an appointment when you need guidance.
Student support services were responsive and the mentorship program really helped first years.
Mental health resources are limited and wait times for counseling appointments are too long.
The peer mentoring program was a great initiative and helped me settle into college life.
More wellness workshops and stress management sessions are needed especially around exams.
The lab equipment is outdated and half the computers in the lab do not work properly.
Labs are overcrowded and we often have to share a single workstation between three students.
The campus wifi is unreliable and internet connectivity in the hostels is extremely poor.
Classroom projectors frequently malfunction and the air conditioning rarely works in summer.
We need modern lab facilities with updated software licenses for our practical coursework.
Infrastructure needs serious investment, from broken chairs to poorly maintained washrooms.
